mapper.select: SELECT admgor.id, ddpags.dates, ddpags.pkg, ddpags.version, ddpags.user_type, IFNULL(ddpr.user_num, 0) new_user_num, ddpl.user_num active_user_num, ddpags.game_code, ddpags.user_num game_user_num, ddpags.play_game_num / ddpl.user_num avg_user_play_game_num, ddpags.play_game_total_time / ddpl.user_num / 60 avg_user_play_time, ddpags.user_num / ddpl.user_num game_permeate_rate, ddpags.total_expend, ddpags.total_expend / ddpl.user_num avg_user_expend, ddpags.total_reward, ddpags.total_reward / ddpl.user_num avg_user_reward, ddpags.rtp FROM dws_daily_package_all_login ddpl LEFT JOIN dws_daily_package_all_register ddpr on (ddpl.dates = ddpr.dates and ddpl.pkg = ddpr.pkg and ddpl.version = ddpr.version) LEFT JOIN dws_daily_package_all_game_single ddpags on (ddpl.dates = ddpags.dates and ddpl.pkg = ddpags.pkg and ddpl.version = ddpags.version) LEFT JOIN ads_daily_mini_game_oeta_report admgor on (admgor.dates = ddpags.dates and admgor.pkg = ddpags.pkg and admgor.version = ddpags.version and admgor.user_type = ddpags.user_type and admgor.game_code = ddpags.game_code) WHERE ddpags.dates = #{dates} and ddpags.game_id = 3 and ddpags.user_type = 0

SELECT admgor.id, ddpags.dates, ddpags.pkg, ddpags.version, ddpags.user_type, IFNULL(ddpr.user_num, 0) new_user_num, ddpl.user_num active_user_num, ddpags.game_code, ddpags.user_num game_user_num, ddpags.play_game_num / ddpr.user_num avg_user_play_game_num, ddpags.play_game_total_time / ddpr.user_num / 60 avg_user_play_time, ddpags.user_num / ddpr.user_num game_permeate_rate, ddpags.total_expend, ddpags.total_expend / ddpr.user_num avg_user_expend, ddpags.total_reward, ddpags.total_reward / ddpr.user_num avg_user_reward, ddpags.rtp FROM dws_daily_package_all_login ddpl LEFT JOIN dws_daily_package_all_register ddpr on (ddpl.dates = ddpr.dates and ddpl.pkg = ddpr.pkg and ddpl.version = ddpr.version) LEFT JOIN dws_daily_package_all_game_single ddpags on (ddpl.dates = ddpags.dates and ddpl.pkg = ddpags.pkg and ddpl.version = ddpags.version) LEFT JOIN ads_daily_mini_game_oeta_report admgor on (admgor.dates = ddpags.dates and admgor.pkg = ddpags.pkg and admgor.version = ddpags.version and admgor.user_type = ddpags.user_type and admgor.game_code = ddpags.game_code) WHERE ddpags.dates = #{dates} and ddpags.game_id = 3 and ddpags.user_type = 1

SELECT id, dates, version, pkg, user_type, new_user_num, active_user_num, game_code, game_user_num, game_permeate_rate, avg_user_play_game_num, avg_user_play_time, total_expend, avg_user_expend, total_reward, avg_user_reward, rtp, create_time FROM analysis_data.ads_daily_mini_game_oeta_report where dates = #{dates}
